entries.zh: 一种生物的晶状体被增强以发射高强度红色激光束。对基因型进行进一步改造可以触发多个眼球的同步发育。
entries.en: The lens of a creature's eyes are enhanced to project high-intensity red laser beams. Further modification of the genome triggers the spontaneous growth of additional eyes.

entries.zh: 通过对视网膜进行基因改良可以让眼部器官投射出更强大的蓝色能量束。
entries.en: Genetically refining the retina allows ocular organs to project a more powerful blue energy beam.

entries.zh: 紫外投射器覆盖在视网膜上，以释放更精确和破坏性的激光束。
entries.en: UV projectors shield the retina in order to discharge a more accurate and destructive laser beam.

entries.zh: 对视网膜的进一步修饰可以使其以更短的波长发出更具有破坏性的激光。
entries.en: Further modification of the retina allows more destructive lasers to fire along a shorter wavelength.

entries.zh: 基因上优化到极致的视觉器官可以发射能量无与伦比的光束，拥有毁灭性的力量。
entries.en: A full genetic overhaul of the ocular organ has created a beam with unmatched power output and destructive potential.

entries.zh: 这种基因修饰刺激了能产生等离子体的腺体和桶状突起的生长，可以将等离子体投射到很远的地方。
entries.en: This genome modification stimulates the growth of plasma-generating glands and barrel-like protuberances to project this plasma over long distances.

entries.zh: 改良有机加速器能够提高射程，避免等离子体外泄，使其能发射更快且更具破坏力的抛射体。
entries.en: Refining the organic accelerators increases range and prevents plasma leakage, creating a faster and more destructive projectile.

entries.zh: 提高生物产生的等离子体的浓度可以让这种生物发射出具有惊人破坏力的抛射体。
entries.en: Intensifying the concentration of biologically-generated plasma allows the creature to launch projectiles with incredible destructive power.

entries.zh: 一种侵入性突变，创造出有机能量投射器，以限制机动能力为代价在极远距离制造毁灭性伤害。
entries.en: An invasive mutation that creates organic energy projectors that deal devastating damage from range at the cost of restricted movement.

entries.zh: 有机能量投射器可以被浓缩成单独的一具生物光矛，让该生物可以发射极端强力的快子光束。
entries.en: Organic energy projectors have been condensed into a singular bio-lance, allowing the creature to fire an extremely powerful tachyon beam.

entries.zh: 受采矿无人机切割激光启发，该突变产出一种特化于在短距离击穿船体的眼光线。
entries.en: Inspired by the Mining Drone cutting laser, this mutation produces an ocular beam specialized in carving through hulls at short range.

entries.zh: 该突变让生物可以制造高浓缩的质子作为强力的抛射弹丸。然而，充能过程可能会较为漫长。
entries.en: This mutation allows a creature to create tight concentrations of protons as a powerful projectile. However, the charging process can be quite lengthy.

entries.zh: 具备利用稍重的中子代替质子的力量，这种高浓度射弹变得更具破坏性。
entries.en: With the ability to harness the power of slightly heavier neutrons in lieu of protons, the concentrated projectiles become more destructive.

entries.zh: 复制破界者物质分解器的力量，装配了这种武器的生物可以轻易地把敌人打碎成基本原子。
entries.en: Replicating the power of Unbidden matter disintegrators, a creature equipped with this bio-weapon can simply reduce an enemy to its base atomic components.

entries.zh: 这种生物武器可以绕过常规防御直接攻击目标本身的组成原子，将化学键敲碎造成致命的船体伤害。
entries.en: These bio-weapons bypass conventional defenses to target the constituent atoms of the target itself, breaking apart molecular bonds to cause critical hull damage.

entries.zh: 这件生物武器发生暴烈的离子流，在不牺牲射速的前提下提升伤害输出。
entries.en: These bio-weapons shoot charges of volatile ion particles, improving damage output with no sacrifice to firing rate.

entries.zh: 这种高度先进的生物武器可以发射势如破竹的量子能流，其撕碎倒霉目标身上化学键的能力无与伦比。
entries.en: Highly advanced bio-weapons that fire charges of unstable quantum energy, unrivaled in their ability to tear apart the molecular bonds of their unfortunate target.

entries.zh: 用生物电导管对现有的呼吸系统进行修改能让生物获得“呼出”穿透性电弧的能力。
entries.en: Modifying existing respiration systems with bio-electrical conduits gives a creature the ability to "breathe" arcs of piercing lightning.

entries.zh: 整合更多的生物能导管让生物可以操纵超充能雷电的狂暴电弧。
entries.en: Integrating additional bio-energy conduits allows a creature to manipulate chaotic arcs of supercharged lightning.

entries.zh: 将突变的电发射器器官稳定化可以提高精度和强度，将狂野的闪电电弧变成精确的纯电破坏光束。
entries.en: Stabilizing mutated electrical emitters increases their accuracy and strength, turning wild lightning arcs into precise beams of pure electrical destruction.

entries.zh: 来自缇杨绮的天然武器，这种变异可以新增加一个能汲取附近敌人能量的器官。
entries.en: Adapted from the natural offenses of Tiyankis, this mutation adds a new organ capable of sapping power from nearby enemies.

entries.zh: 太空变形虫天然武器的衍生型，该器官可以发射太虚光束，具有独特的以熵来抵消等量能量的能力。
entries.en: A variant of Space Amoeba natural offenses, this organ produces Null Void Beams with the unique ability to counteract energy with an equal force of entropy.

entries.zh: 骨片加速器将静电势武器化，以极快的速度发射磁化的骨头碎片。
entries.en: Weaponizing latent static electricity, Shard Accelerators launch magnetized shards of bone at extreme velocities.

entries.zh: 电神经通路的线圈增强了静电放电，让该生物可以更快的初速发射磁化骨片。
entries.en: The coiling of electric nerve pathways improves static recharge, allowing the creature to launch magnetized shards at increased velocity.

entries.zh: 轨道状附肢将化学能转化为电能，产生强大的磁场以发射致命的弹丸。
entries.en: Rail-like appendages convert chemical energy into electricity, generating a powerful magnetic field to launch deadly projectiles.

entries.zh: 额外的发电附肢增加了轨道炮的电荷，加速了弹丸速度，能够提高杀伤力。
entries.en: Additional electricity-producing appendages increase the rail's charge, accelerating projectile speed for improved lethality.

entries.zh: 错综复杂的卷曲附肢能够聚集大量的有机电力，以无与伦比的速度发射弹丸。
entries.en: Intricate, coiled appendages harness massive amounts of organic electricity in order to launch projectiles at unmatched speed.

entries.zh: 额外的孔洞能够以惊人的射速喷射出包裹着易爆液体的坚硬骨片。
entries.en: Additional orifices discharge volleys of volatile fluids encased in hardened shards of bone at an impressive fire rate.

entries.zh: 加长喷管并改进骨片构成使这些棘刺炮能够发射由更致命的易爆弹药形成的弹幕。
entries.en: Lengthened orifice barrels and improved shard formation allows these thorn cannons to launch even deadlier volleys of volatile ordnance.

entries.zh: 大幅提高易爆液体的浓度可以让骨片的弹幕熔穿护盾，腐蚀金属，并以惊人的效率撕裂血肉。
entries.en: Heavily increasing the concentration of the volatile fluid allows the barrage of bone shards to melt through shields, corrode metal, and tear through flesh with incredible efficiency.

entries.zh: 这些棘刺炮用自我复制的纳米机器人取代了有机弹药，可以释放短程电磁脉冲，并穿透任何材料。
entries.en: Having replaced organic ammunition with self-replicating nanites, these thorn cannons can unleash short-range EMPs and chew through any material.

entries.zh: 这种变异虽然笨重，但能够形成致密的几丁质杆，并拥有从远距离以高速发射它们的能力。
entries.en: This unwieldy mutation grants the ability to form dense chitinous rods and launch them at high velocity from long range.

entries.zh: 额外的支撑附肢可以提高炮口初速和稳定性，增强有机火炮的威力。
entries.en: Additional support appendages allow greater muzzle velocity and stability, adding power to organic artillery.

entries.zh: 这种轰炸性质的变异笨重且具有侵入性，严重阻碍了生物的行动，需要精准的瞄准才能发挥作用。然而，这些缺点被武器的强大破坏力所弥补。
entries.en: Cumbersome and invasive, this bombardment mutation heavily impedes a creature's movements and requires precise targeting to be effective. These drawbacks are more than compensated for by the weapon's raw destructive power.

entries.zh: 有机膛线的改进使这种轰炸武器能够以更高的速度发射更大的弹丸，从而实现极其强大的炮击。
entries.en: Modifications to organic rifling allow this bombardment weapon to launch even larger projectiles at increased velocity for extremely powerful artillery strikes.

entries.zh: 该生物武器由一个孕育舱和一个半成形的易爆幼体组成，有效地充当了定向导弹。一旦与孕育舱分离，爆炸性幼体将本能地向目标发射并在撞击时爆炸。
entries.en: Composed of a gestative pod and a partially-formed volatile spawn, this bio-weapon effectively functions as a targeted missile. Once separated from its pod, the explosive spawn will instinctively launch itself toward the chosen target and detonate on impact.

entries.zh: 将弹丸涂上浓缩的易挥发瘴气可以提高弹丸速度，并增强爆炸性载荷。
entries.en: Coating the spawn projectile in concentrated volatile miasma allows for improved projectile speed and a more potent explosive payload.

entries.zh: 通过改变生成弹药的形成过程，将不稳定反物质有效载荷整合到其中，可以提高爆炸威力。
entries.en: Altering the formation process of the spawn projectile to integrate a payload of unstable antimatter has increased its explosive power.

entries.zh: 孕育过程的改进使得量子产卵弹的制造成为可能。这些活体导弹可以从零点真空汲取能量，释放出难以置信的破坏力。
entries.en: Improvements in the gestation process allows for the creation of quantum spawn projectiles. These living missiles can draw energy from a zero point vacuum to unleash incredible destructive power.

entries.zh: 基因改造赋予了该投射生物近乎完整的意识，提升了飞行性能和弱点瞄准能力。这种增强带来的道德影响相当复杂。
entries.en: Genetic tweaking has granted the projectile creature near-complete sentience, improving flight performance and weak-spot targeting. The moral implications of this enhancement are somewhat complex.

entries.zh: 一种瘴气发射器的变体，它用一团孢子球代替了半智能弹丸，这些孢子球会在撞击时爆炸。弹丸的高密度使得这种变异很难被点防御系统拦截。
entries.en: A variant of the miasma launcher that replaces its semi-sentient projectile with a cloud of spore bulbs that explode on impact. The high density of projectiles makes this mutation difficult to intercept with point-defense systems.

entries.zh: 基因改良提高了弹药的爆炸性，并增强了其寻找目标和投放爆炸性有效载荷的能力。
entries.en: Genetic improvements have increased the volatility of the bulbs and improved their ability to seek their target and deliver their explosive payload.

entries.zh: 由多余覆层形成的生物鱼雷，内部充满爆炸性液体。特殊的等离子涂层使这些制导弹药能够穿透能量屏障。
entries.en: Bio-torpedoes formed from excess mantle and filled with explosive fluids. A special plasmic coating allows these guided munitions to pass through energy barriers.

entries.zh: 生物鱼雷添加了装甲外壳，使其能够抵御点防御弹药。爆炸后，外壳会碎裂成穿透性的弹片，从而提高破坏力。
entries.en: The addition of an armored carapace allows bio-torpedoes to withstand point-defense munitions. Once detonated, this carapace shatters into piercing shrapnel, increasing destructive power.

entries.zh: 提高爆炸载荷的浓度和粘度，使其在爆炸前更好地穿透目标的防御。
entries.en: An increase in the concentration and viscosity of the explosive payload allows it to better penetrate a target's defenses before detonation.

entries.zh: 这些装甲弹药整合了虫群天灾的遗传物质，它们会将受害者分解，以便之后吞噬。它们在远程攻击中致命，并且具有很高的耐久性，结合了导弹和鱼雷的最强特性。
entries.en: Integrating the genetic material of the Prethoryn Scourge, these armored munitions break apart their victims to facilitate later consumption. Deadly at long range and individually durable, they combine the strongest traits of both missiles and torpedoes.

entries.zh: 生物大炮构成的炮组可发射集束爆炸针刺。这种武器专门用于控制大片空间以拦截敌方舰载机和导弹。
entries.en: Bio-gun batteries that discharge clusters of explosive barbs. This weapon specializes in controlling large swathes of space to intercept enemy strike craft and missiles.

entries.zh: 增加针刺集束口径可以更有效地控制区域，并提高对敌方舰载机的伤害。
entries.en: An increase in barb cluster caliber allows for more effective zone control and increased damage to enemy strike craft.

entries.zh: 炮管延长并与生物神经中枢更直接连接可以提高炮口初速，并改善对敌方舰载机的追踪能力。
entries.en: Barrel extension and a more direct connection to the creature's nerve center allows for greater muzzle velocity as well as improved tracking of strike craft movement.

entries.zh: 爆炸针刺能够在引爆时产生纳米云。这些微型促动器能够以极快的速度吞噬敌方的舰载机。
entries.en: Explosive barbs that create nanite clouds on detonation. These tiny actuators are capable of eating through strike craft at a tremendous rate.

entries.zh: 这个器官可以以极快的速度“啐射”少量腐蚀性物质。额外的眼部受体可以精确追踪来袭的攻击机和导弹。
entries.en: An organ that 'spits' small quantities of corrosive material at exceptional rate. Additional ocular receptors allow for precision tracking of incoming strike craft and missiles.

entries.zh: 专用突触的生长提高了点防御行动中的目标定位和火力效率。
entries.en: The growth of dedicated synapses improves targeting and fire efficiency in point-defense operations.

entries.zh: 分泌半独立的酶到腐蚀性液体中，可以提高靶向性并提高威胁拦截率。
entries.en: Secreting semi-independent enzymes into the corrosive fluid allows for improved targeting and an increased rate of threat interception.

entries.zh: 虽然比野外发现的变形虫鞭毛弱，但这些不稳定的后代群仍然保留着基本的舰载机攻击能力。
entries.en: While weaker than Amoeba flagella found in the wild, swarms of these unstable spawn retain basic strike craft capabilities.

entries.zh: 这些鞭毛在所有指标上都经过基因增强，能够更好地追踪目标并吸收敌方火力。
entries.en: Genetically enhanced across all metrics, these flagella are better able to track targets and absorb enemy fire.

entries.zh: 将义体增强技术整合到鞭毛中，创造了更具弹性和攻击力的舰载机群。
entries.en: Integrating cybernetic enhancements into flagella has created a more resilient and powerful strike swarm.

entries.zh: 对鞭毛的组织进行基因改造，创造了一种超越自然界任何生物的变形虫亚种。这种被称为“超级鞭毛”的半自主舰载机拥有强大的攻击能力，同时对弹药的抵抗力也更强。
entries.en: A genetic overhaul of the flagella organism has created an Amoeba subspecies that surpasses anything found in nature. Known as 'Super Flagella', these semi-autonomous strike craft offer immense offensive capabilities as well as increased resistance to munitions.

entries.zh: 采用斯卡拉维德技术的植入物使超级鞭毛能够将它们已经非凡的能力提升到更高的水平。
entries.en: Implants developed with Skravird technology allow Super Flagella to elevate their already exceptional capabilities to even greater heights.

entries.zh: 一种基于远古蓝图的自调控激光透镜。这种眼光线在强度和频率上产生自发波动以凿穿装甲板，是一种致命高效的武器。
entries.en: A self-regulating laser lens based on ancient blueprints. This eye beam fluctuates automatically in intensity and frequency to carve through armor plating, functioning as a deadly and efficient weapon.

entries.zh: 这种有机武器利用空间中存在的电场来过载大量的硬化骨片。是生物线圈武器的一种衍生版本，这种散射弹药精准度较低，但可以从更远的距离攻击目标。
entries.en: This organic weapon harnesses electric fields present in space to supercharge a large quantity of hardened bone shards. A variant on bio-coil weaponry, this spread munitions are less accurate but can engage targets from longer range.

entries.zh: 这种生物武器基于远古饱和剂发射炮，发射充满着易爆液体的小囊泡来过载目标的能量防护并摧毁其中的舰船。
entries.en: Based on ancient saturator artillery, this bio-weapon fires small pockets of volatile liquids to overcharge energy barriers and shred the insides of a vessel.

entries.zh: 仿照一份远古设计图，这种类似雄蕊的器官会发射出大量的微型生物鱼雷孢子。其较小的口径能让弹药直接切断外部防御和破坏关键的内部系统。
entries.en: Following an ancient schematic, this organ resembling a flower's stamen launches volleys of mini bio-torpedo spores. The smaller caliber allows for the munitions to cut through external defenses and damage critical internal systems directly.

entries.zh: 经过基因改造的鞭毛看起来像古代的钻孔无人机。这些舰载机使用生物光束武器，可以穿透装甲对内部系统造成直接伤害。
entries.en: Flagella genetically modified to resemble ancient driller drones. These strike craft wield bio-beam weapons that can penetrate armor to deal direct damage to internal systems.

entries.zh: 这种生物点防系统仿照远古的设计，利用一种扩张网刺和主动射弹拦截来犯的弹药、缠住舰载机群。
entries.en: Following ancient designs, these bio-point defense systems harness expanding web-like strings alongside offensive projectiles to intercept incoming munitions and tangle swarms of strike craft.

entries.zh: 将场操控器整合进生物的上皮使其可以创造稳定的能量壁垒，提高生存率。
entries.en: Integrating field manipulators into the creature's epidermis allows a creature to create a stable energy barrier, enhancing their survivability.

entries.zh: 改进版本的上皮能量屏障可以优化内部化学能转化过程。
entries.en: A reinforced version of the epidermal energy barrier has been made possible by the optimization of internal chemical energy conversion.

entries.zh: 嫁接上具有生物能投射器的新上皮有助于形成复杂的多层防御场，增加生物的适应力。
entries.en: Grafting a new epidermis filled with bio-energy projectors allows for the formation of intricate and layered defense fields, increasing a creature's resilience.

entries.zh: 增强生物能上皮的能量输出能创造更强大的防御场。只有持续不断的火力可以击穿此屏障。
entries.en: Augmentations to the power output of the bio-energetic epidermis creates an even stronger defensive field that can only be breached by sustained enemy fire.

entries.zh: 这种生物能屏障得到进一步增强，是常规能量防御的巅峰。
entries.en: Further reinforced and intensified, this bio-energetic barrier is the pinnacle of conventional energy defenses.

entries.zh: 能量上皮的一种复杂变体，它投射屏障违背物理定律，用稳定的暗物质键来偏转入射的射弹。
entries.en: A complex variant form of the energy epidermis, its projected barrier defies the laws of physics to deflect incoming projectiles with stabilized dark matter bonds.

entries.zh: 利用虚境能量的高等级上皮场发生器。它可以投射近乎无法洞穿的防御屏障，让射弹在接触的瞬间就蒸发。
entries.en: High-grade epidermal field generators that harness the power of the Shroud. It projects a near-unbreakable defensive barrier that can cause projectiles to vanish on contact.

entries.zh: 这种能量上皮可以从太虚维度汲取能量，无限再生所有完整性损失。
entries.en: This energy epidermis draws its power from the Null Void Dimension, allowing it to endlessly regenerate any loss in its integrity.

entries.zh: 对生物的基因型进行小规模调整可以让矿物质养分在皮肤以上形成具有纳米构造的保护性甲壳。
entries.en: Small modifications in a creature's genome allows for mineral nutrients to form a protective nanocomposite shell over the epidermis.

entries.zh: 对生物体的天然装甲用微观复合陶瓷进行补强可以提高生存率。
entries.en: Reinforcement of a creature's natural armor with microscopic ceramic compounds increases survivability.

entries.zh: 精确的基因调控可以将塑钢整合进生物的甲壳内。
entries.en: Precise genome alterations allow for the integration of plasteel into a creature's carapace.

entries.zh: 有机生长的耐钢版让这种生物可以抵御更多射弹伤害。
entries.en: The organic growth of durasteel armor plates makes creatures more resistant to damage from munitions.

entries.zh: 刺激生长零素装甲板需要将生物的基因组推至极限。这种卓越的坚固甲壳可以抵御能瞬间液化其他防御的伤害。
entries.en: Stimulating the growth of Neutronium armor plates requires pushing the creature's genome to its limits. This extraordinarily robust carapace can withstand damage that would liquify other defenses.

entries.zh: 通过对太空巨龙基因的分析，我们获得了将其遗传物质与我们生物的遗传物质拼接起来的必要工具。这种融合将使它们的甲壳上长出坚固到难以置信的龙鳞，能大大提高生存能力。
entries.en: Through the analysis of the space dragon's genome, we've gained the essential tools to splice its genetic material with our creatures'. This fusion would enable the growth of impossibly strong dragon scales atop their carapaces, significantly enhancing their survivability.

entries.zh: 元素合金与器官衬里相结合形成一种伪内骨骼，从而提高生物的结构完整性。
entries.en: Elemental alloys integrated into organ lining creates a pseudo-endoskeleton, improving the creature's structural integrity.

entries.zh: 用晶体元素补强器官可以产生一种保护关键身体系统的有机合金。
entries.en: Reinforcing organs with crystalline elements creates an organic alloy that protects vital bodily systems.

entries.zh: 受古代悬浮场启发，这种屏障表皮中存在的生物生成器能够在接触时抵御穿透性弹药。
entries.en: Inspired by ancient suspension fields, the bio-generators present in this barrier epidermis are able to reject penetrative munitions on contact.

entries.zh: 这种充能甲壳是根据古代盔甲板的图案设计的。超强能量编织在生物再生表皮和坚韧皮革层之间，既可以充当护盾，也可以充当盔甲。
entries.en: This energized carapace was designed following ancient patterns of armor plating. Supercharged energy is woven between layers of bio-generating epidermis and durable hide, able to serve as both shields and armor.

entries.zh: 辅助触须可以让生物更好地控制自己的运动，并产生更大的推力。
entries.en: Supplemental tendrils allow a creature to better control its movements as well as generate increased thrust.

entries.zh: 这些触须具有额外的关节点，使其能够更精确、更高效地进行机动，躲避敌人并产生推力。
entries.en: These tendrils have additional points of articulation, allowing for more precise and efficient maneuvers to evade enemies and generate thrust.

entries.zh: 晶体鳞片以晶格形式排列，利用反应性碎裂来吸收重击。
entries.en: Crystal scales formed in a lattice use reactive shattering to absorb heavy blows.

entries.zh: 用活体金属代替晶体可以让鳞片移动和重新分布，以吸收来袭的攻击，保护生物免受穿透性弹药的伤害。
entries.en: Replacing crystal with living metal allows the scales to shift and redistribute to absorb incoming attacks, protecting the creature from penetrative munitions.

entries.zh: 一种利用磁场势能来增强生物能量屏障并偏转穿透性弹药的器官。
entries.en: An organ that harnesses latent magnetic fields to strengthen a creature's energy barriers and deflect penetrative munitions.

entries.zh: 对力场操控器官进行的义体增强进一步提高了生物能量屏障的韧性。
entries.en: Cybernetic enhancements to the field-manipulating organ further improves the resilience of a creature's energy barrier.

entries.zh: 一种增强生物认知中枢的装置，可以提升其本能战斗能力和武器精准度。
entries.en: An augment to the cognitive center of a creature that improves natural fighting instinct and weapon accuracy.

entries.zh: 来自神秘堡垒系统的义体神经中枢可以提高生物的协调性和武器精度。
entries.en: Cybernetic nerve centers taken from the systems of the Enigmatic Fortress improve a creature's coordination and weapon accuracy.

entries.zh: 将神秘编码器连接到生物的神经系统可以隐藏其能量特征，从而方便快速撤退。
entries.en: Connecting Enigmatic Encoders into a creature's nervous system can cloak its energy signature to facilitate a swift retreat.

entries.zh: 表皮上的一层薄薄的变色晶体赋予生物隐形的能力。
entries.en: A thin layer of color-shifting crystals along the epidermis grants a creature the ability to cloak.

entries.zh: 该生物真皮中的纳米晶体配备了精确的传感器，可以快速适应以保持隐形。
entries.en: Equipped with precise sensors, the nanocrystals in the creature's dermis can adapt rapidly in order to maintain stealth.

entries.zh: 纳米晶格的多层结构使复杂的隐形技术成为可能，使生物完全隐形。
entries.en: Multiple layers of nanocrystalline lattice allows for complex cloaking techniques, rendering the creature completely invisible.

entries.zh: 将暗物质融入纳米晶体，可以让生物躲避除最复杂的探测阵列之外的所有探测。
entries.en: Integrating dark matter into the nanocrystals allows a creature to elude all but the most complex detection arrays.

entries.zh: 带有灵能的纳米晶体将生物的视觉信息发送到虚境中，使其在这个物质存在位面上无法被感知，同时保留其力场操控防御。
entries.en: Psionically-charged nanocrystals send a creature's visual information into the Shroud, preventing it from being perceived on this plane of existence while leaving its field-manipulation defenses intact.

entries.zh:
$CAMOUFLAGE_1_TOOLTIP$

§E如果仅装备有$PSIONIC_SKIN$或者$PSIONIC_EPIDERMIS$则可以避免$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$。装有任何其他类型的护盾都会失去该效果。§!
entries.en:
$CAMOUFLAGE_1_TOOLTIP$

§E$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$ can be prevented if $PSIONIC_SKIN$ or $PSIONIC_EPIDERMIS$ are equipped on their own. The use of any other shield type will negate this effect.§!

entries.zh: 能够在轨道轰炸期间作为额外弹药抛射出去的密集弹药，用于压倒行星防御网并造成额外伤害。
entries.en: Dense masses that can be jettisoned as additional projectiles during orbital bombardment to overwhelm planetary defense grids and deal additional damage.

entries.zh: 我们的虚境超主的印记增强了我们的心灵能力，并赐予我们的生物对战斗的渴望。
entries.en: The mark of our Shroud Patron amplifies our psionic abilities and blesses our creatures with a thirst for combat.

entries.zh: 我们的虚境超主的印记增强了我们的心灵能力，并赐予我们的生物毁灭的天赋。
entries.en: The mark of our Shroud Patron amplifies our psionic abilities and blesses our creatures with a gift for devastation.

entries.zh: 我们的虚境超主的印记增强了我们的心灵能力，并赋予我们的生物一种渴求感和紧迫感。
entries.en: The mark of our Shroud Patron amplifies our psionic abilities and blesses our creatures with a sense of purpose and urgency.

entries.zh: 我们的虚境超主的印记增强了我们的心灵能力，并赋予我们的生物耀眼的外表。
entries.en: The mark of our Shroud Patron amplifies our psionic abilities and blesses our creatures with luminous presence.

entries.zh: 我们的虚境超主的印记增强了我们的心灵能力，并赋予我们的生物敏捷和活力。
entries.en: The mark of our Shroud Patron amplifies our psionic abilities and blesses our creatures with agility and vigor.

entries.zh: 充满繁殖液的囊肿使每个处于繁殖的三头虫形态的虚空虫在轰炸有人居住的星球时都能独立产卵。
entries.en: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.

entries.zh: 经过改造的鞭毛会从猎物中吸取营养物质和材料，以支持宿主变形虫的再生。
entries.en: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇的幽暗歌声鼓舞着它的同胞，坚定战斗决心。
entries.en: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.

entries.zh: 岩居兽强大的消化系统可以改造用于以极高初速发射动能抛射体。
entries.en: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.

entries.zh: 冗余的思维中心允许晶态实体将自身一分为二，作为最后的巧谋来保护它的后代免受特别危险的敌人的攻击。
entries.en: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.

entries.zh: 融合了虚空孳孽基因物质的生物体不再需要进食，它们可以直接从星光中吸收能量。
entries.en: Lifeforms infused with the genetic material of Voidspawn no longer need to feed, they simply absorb energy from starlight.

entries.zh: 将柔性生物材料整合到天然防御系统中，可以保护天然薄弱部位，减少冲击损伤。
entries.en: The integration of flexible biomaterial into natural defenses protects natural weak spots and reduces impact damage.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇族母在临死前会释放一系列保护性化学物质，这是她最后一次试图保护剩余族群的生命。
entries.en: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.

entries.zh: 人工精神连接增强战斗感官，最大限度地发挥变异攻击能力。
entries.en: Artificial mental connections enhance combat senses and maximize the power of mutated offensive capabilities.

entries.zh: 增强后的疼痛感受器发出冲击波，遍布整个神经系统，激发生物的防御本能，并释放出更大的破坏潜力。
entries.en: Enhanced pain receptors send shocks that spread throughout the nervous system, fueling a creature's defensive instincts and unlocking greater destructive potential.

entries.zh: 用一种可以经过生物编程、在生物死亡时爆炸的自然液体炸药填充生物体的空腔，这是可以实现的。
entries.en: It is possible to fill the hollow cavities of lifeforms with a natural liquid explosive that can be biologically programmed to explode upon death.
